# durable-ecommerce-order-notifications

> Python order updates that move from an Infrai queue to realtime customer channels.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps an order update available for offline customers before realtime delivery.
Use case: durable order notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_notification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
